title: Mechanism Parity for Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous-Driving Perception
abstract: arXiv:2611.27447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation is central to intelligent-vehicle validation, but visual realism or output agreement between a real scene and its synthetic counterpart does not prove that a perception system used the same evidence in both domains. This paper addresses that mechanism-parity gap for paired real-synthetic autonomous-driving perception. It unifies Decisive-Feature Fidelity, which compares decisive evidence maps in a frozen system under test (SUT), with Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity, which projects decisive evidence into semantic scene concepts for diagnosis. The framework is a validation diagnostic rather than a standalone safety certificate: it asks whether output-consistent simulation also preserves the mechanism by which the perception model reaches that output. translated_title: 面向自动驾驶感知仿真验证的机制对等性
translated_abstract: 摘要：仿真在智能车辆验证中处于核心地位，但真实场景与其合成对应物之间的视觉真实感或输出一致性，并不能证明感知系统在两个领域中使用了相同的证据。本文针对配对的真实-合成自动驾驶感知中的“机制对等性缺口”展开研究。该工作将“决定性特征保真度”（比较冻结的被测系统（SUT）中的决定性证据图）与“概念-决定性特征保真度”（将决定性证据投影到语义场景概念中用于诊断）统一起来。该框架是一种验证诊断工具，而非独立的安全证书：它追问的是，输出一致的仿真是否同样保留了感知模型得出该输出所依赖的机制。实证证据包括在确定性精确几何的 KITTI-Virtual KITTI 2 子集上评估的十个重新训练的扩散 ControlNet 生成器。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“机制对等性”诊断框架，通过统一决定性特征保真度（DFF）与概念-决定性特征保真度（CDFF），验证输出一致的仿真是否保留了感知模型做出判断的内部证据机制，而不仅是视觉逼真或输出一致。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mechanism-parity diagnostic framework that unifies Decisive-Feature Fidelity and Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity to verify whether output-consistent simulation preserves the same internal evidence mechanisms a perception model relies on, beyond mere visual realism or output agreement.
